about: An emerald-cut centre is flanked by two tapered baguettes, all four corners protected by fine prongs. The step cuts line up along a single axis so the ring reads as one continuous plane of light.
why_this_works: Three step-cut stones share the same cutting language, so the eye moves across the ring without interruption. The tapered side stones lengthen the hand and let the centre stone feel larger than its weight.
wedding_band_fit: Needs a shaped or contour band to sit closely against the side stones.

specifications.wedding_band_fit: Needs a shaped or contour band to sit closely against the side stones.

variation_note: Carat weight, accent-stone count, metal weight and dimensions may vary with ring size, centre stone and custom configuration.
